title: Great!
text: We were out with Gerard B. and felt completely comfortable. With passion and extreme friendliness, we were informed competently and knowledgeably and were able to enjoy the time in a relaxed manner despite the overwhelming impressions. It was really fun! We will always remember it fondly. Thanks Gerard!
author: falo66

title: La Familia
text: The tour was excellent. Our guide was very thorough and knew everything about La Familia and more.
author: brianxhristi

title: Gonzalo was the best!
text: Gonzalo was an incredible guide. He gave us the history, the beauty and local knowledge of a person that grew up in the area
author: thomastZ8IW

title: The best tour EVER
text: I’ve been on guided tours all over the world and seldom found my guides as knowledgeable and enthusiastic as Gemma. She made the experience delightful and informative.
author: edfJ5164JJ

title: Sagrada Familia private tours
text: Dolors was great!  She was knowledgeable and friendly.  She took her time and explained so much.  There were 4 of us, and we all appreciated Dolors’ style and commentary.  The tour was well worth the price we paid.
author: juliepP9243JM

title: Unforgettable
text: Communication before the visit was good and finding the meeting place was easy. Eleni was knowledgeable, spoke clearly, made sure everyone in the group was involved and asked questions that, as well as being fun, kept us focussed. The length of the visit was just right and Eleni made it clear that we could explore other areas of the Sagrada Familia after the guided tour had ended.
author: grandma1969

title: The whole experience...
text: The whole experience brought tears to my eyes.   I could feel Gaudi's faith and I feel blessed to be have been able to experience the Familia in person.
author: Terri_V

title: Informative and Fun!
text: This tour is a must-do in Barcelona! Because it was private, we were able to hear everything, see what we wanted and ask lots of questions. Isaac S. was an enthusiastic and knowledgeable guide...and never boring! We loved this tour. Thank you Tours for Today and Isaac S!!
author: bmar07

title: Super guide Isaac
text: For a unique experience , take Isaac as a guide. He is lively and extremely talented. We were delighted! Thanks a bunch!!
author: similic

title: EXCELLENT TOUR WITH A WONDERFUL STORYTELLER
text: Isaac S was our tour guide and he was the best guide we have ever had.  He brought Sagrada Familia and Gaudi to life!  I went into the tour not a fan of Gaudi but wanting to check off the box of Sagrada Familia to being a huge fan.  It was able to provide history to us with color and he was a truly gifted storyteller.  Thank you and give the man a raise!
author: elizabethsP8297PG
